video: 30-second vertical explainer that shows beginners how a neural network learns to spot spam emails

email_card_enter.what: The suspicious email card fades in and rises into place at the top

spam_arrow_draw.what: A violet arrow draws from the email toward a Spam folder

spam_folder_enter.what: A folder labeled Spam fades into view

envelope_to_folder.what: A small envelope travels along the arrow into the Spam folder

folder_pulse.what: The Spam folder briefly swells and settles when the envelope arrives

folder_exit.what: The folder and arrow fade away

rule_cards_enter.what: Hand-written rule cards appear one after another, faster and faster, each fading in and rising

rule_cards_exit.what: The pile of rule cards tilts and slides off the screen

variant_card_enter.what: A new scam email card slides in from the right

question_mark_enter.what: A large violet question mark appears above the new scam email

variant_card_exit.what: The new scam email card fades away

network_draw.what: The network's circles and connecting lines draw themselves

clues_to_inputs.what: The email's clues drop from the card into the input circles as numbers

input_labels_enter.what: Labels for each clue fade in beside the input circles

weights_grow.what: Connection lines grow thicker or thinner to show how much each clue matters

forward_pulses.what: Purple dots travel along the connections from inputs to neurons at a steady speed

neuron_plus_enter.what: A plus sign appears in each hidden neuron as it adds its inputs

neuron_activation_glow.what: Each hidden neuron glows according to how strong its signal is

output_score_enter.what: The output score 'Spam: 30%' fades in under the output neuron

answer_card_enter.what: A 'Right answer: Spam' card slides in beside the output

error_bar_grow.what: A violet error bar grows between the guess and the right answer

backward_pulses.what: Purple dots travel backward from the output to the inputs at a steady speed

weights_adjust.what: The connection lines change thickness as the weights are adjusted

example_flip.what: The email card flips quickly to show one training example after another

counter_count_up.what: A counter of examples seen counts up from 1 to 10,000

score_count_up.what: The spam score counts up from 30% to 97%

error_bar_shrink.what: The error bar shrinks as the network improves

answer_card_exit.what: The right-answer card and error bar fade away

output_verdict.what: The output neuron glows violet and its label changes to 'Likely spam'

caption_enter.what: A short explanation line under the network fades in and rises

caption_exit.what: The explanation line fades out before the next one appears

camera_zoom.what: The camera zooms out slightly to fit the whole network

world_fade_out.what: The whole scene fades away before the logo appears

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind an invisible edge

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out at the end of its scene

subtitle_words.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as the narrator says them

logo_bars_grow.what: Four logo bars grow upward from a baseline one after another, left to right

logo_wordmark_reveal.what: The brand name is revealed left to right by a moving edge

logo_glow.what: The logo bars glow brighter, then settle to a soft glow

tagline_enter.what: The tagline fades in and rises into place under the logo

cta_enter.what: The call-to-action button fades in and rises into place

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow on the button slides a little to the right once
